step(T0)
  T0 opens S0
step(T0)
  T0 spawns T1 into S0
step(T0)
  T0 joins S0 (JOINING)
step(T1)
  T1 spawns T2 into S0

  T1 ends Succeeded

  mark T2 grandchild
step(T2)
step(T2)
  T2 ends Succeeded
step(T0)
  T0 closes S0
step(T0)
step(T0)
  process exit 0
outcome: exit=0
